# Fastex Media

> Fastex Media is a B2B-only lead generation agency. We build multi-channel outbound systems — performance marketing, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp and cold email — that book qualified sales meetings for business-to-business companies worldwide.

Founded June 2025 by Aagam Shah (Founder). B2B only — we do
not run direct-to-consumer campaigns. We work with clients worldwide and report
on qualified meetings booked rather than impressions or lead counts.

Contact: hello@fastexmedia.com · +91 9328680929

## Services

- [Performance Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/performance-marketing/): Paid acquisition on LinkedIn, Google and Meta built around qualified B2B pipeline — not clicks, impressions or vanity leads.
- [LinkedIn Lead Generation](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/linkedin-marketing/): Outbound to named decision-makers — researched, sequenced and booked straight into your sales calendar.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Organic presence that makes your company the obvious choice when a business buyer finally starts shortlisting vendors.
- [WhatsApp Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/whatsapp-marketing/): Official WhatsApp Business API journeys for B2B enquiry response, distributor networks and pipeline follow-up.
- [Cold Email Marketing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/services/email-marketing/): Cold outbound infrastructure and lifecycle email that reaches the inbox and earns replies from senior buyers.

## Industries

- [IT & Software](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/it-software/): B2B lead generation for IT and software firms. We book qualified meetings with CTOs, IT directors and technical buyers via cold email, LinkedIn and paid demand.
- [Solar & Renewable Energy](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/solar-renewable/): Commercial solar lead generation for EPCs and renewable providers. We book meetings with facility managers, plant heads and CFOs for high-ticket C&I projects.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/manufacturing/): B2B lead generation for manufacturers and exporters. We open conversations with procurement heads, sourcing managers and distributors, beyond trade shows.
- [Educational Institutes](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/education/): B2B marketing for universities, school groups and EdTech. We build corporate partnerships, institutional tie-ups and qualified admission enquiry systems.
- [Real Estate](https://www.fastexmedia.com/industries/real-estate/): B2B lead generation for commercial real estate. We reach corporate tenants, channel partners and investors for developers and brokerages — beyond portal leads.

## Articles

- [Performance Marketing for SaaS: Building a Predictable Lead Engine](https://www.fastexmedia.com/blog/performance-marketing-for-saas/): How B2B SaaS companies use performance marketing to book qualified demos, not just collect clicks. Channel mix, creative testing and the metrics that matter.
- [Cold Email vs LinkedIn Outreach: Which Generates Better B2B Leads?](https://www.fastexmedia.com/blog/cold-email-vs-linkedin-outreach/): Honest data from running both channels daily: reply rates, real costs, scaling limits, and why prospects touched on both channels reply at twice the rate.
- [B2B Lead Generation in 2026: 7 Strategies That Actually Fill Pipelines](https://www.fastexmedia.com/blog/b2b-lead-generation-strategies/): The 7 highest-ROI B2B lead generation strategies we run daily: multi-channel outbound, LinkedIn authority, WhatsApp outreach and how to stack them.
- [WhatsApp Marketing for B2B: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://www.fastexmedia.com/blog/whatsapp-marketing-for-b2b-guide/): WhatsApp gets 90%+ open rates while B2B emails sit unread. The system we use to book meetings: API setup, broadcasts, automation and real results.
